title: +*WRITING IN BUSINESS
description: Develops skills in written workplace communication with a focus on rhetorical practice. Explores effective document structure, sentence construction, incorporation of research, collaborative writing, and writing processes. Provides practice in a variety of complex professional contexts and in a variety of workplace genres, such as emails, reports, resumes, and cover letters.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: WR 121Z, 121HZ, 121, 121H or minimum score of 1 in 'Exam for Waiver - WR 121'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in WR 121Z, WR 121HZ, WR 121 and WR 121H.
